supplemental_validation: live doctor, deals, full sync, local search, and export proof
spec_backed_mock_limitations: The generic resource-path check assumes export.go reads from an HTTP resource path, while Woot export intentionally reads only from the local SQLite archive.

The generic mock pipeline recognizes GraphQL CLIs by an internal/client/graphql.go filename; Woot's promoted read-only GraphQL command and guard use different package files, so the mock attempts an inapplicable OpenAPI-style sync.
notes: Structural verification is the documented verifier mode for CLIs whose real workflow cannot be synthesized from the supplied API spec.
The two disclosed mock-mode limitations are Printing Press classifier mismatches, not suppressed Woot runtime failures.
No credential value or private filesystem path is stored in this proof.
